status: r2 (2026-10-10, Q-1 completion): adds CON/N9001 (Safety & PPE, task T1) to practical_nos_for_matching. r1 only scored the 4 electrical-practical NOS and never surfaced T1 in applicable_tasks, which was a traceability gap — CON/N9001 is practical/task-evidenced per qp.json (see docs/qp/CON_Q0602_v4_source_of_truth.md). r2 also adds declaration_only_nos (CON/N8001, CON/N8002): their cards are linked and surfaced to the worker/assessor as declaration_only_signals, but deliberately excluded from practical_nos_for_matching, so they never move overall_coverage/match_result — teamwork and plan-and-organise are generic employability behaviours, not Assistant-Electrician-specific trade skill, consistent with rubric.json's existing DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE pathway for these NOS. No independent assessor-agreement study has been run against r1 or r2 — see docs/gates/IC1A.md. A future version bump (r3+) follows the same rule: a new rules id, never an in-place edit of this file's meaning.

declaration_only_nos.label: Teamwork
declaration_only_nos.reason: generic employability behaviour, not Assistant-Electrician trade skill; declaration-only per rubric.json DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE pathway

declaration_only_nos.label: Plan & organise
declaration_only_nos.reason: generic employability behaviour, not Assistant-Electrician trade skill; declaration-only per rubric.json DECLARATION_OR_ASSESSOR_NOTE pathway

nos_coverage_formula: coverage(NOS) = sum(effective_claim(pc) for pc in linked_pcs(NOS)) / count(linked_pcs(NOS)), where effective_claim(pc) = max over links touching pc of (answer_strength(card_or_tool_answer) x link.weight), clamped to [0,1]. PCs with no card/tool link (see links.json.known_gaps) are excluded from both sides of this ratio.
overall_coverage_formula: overall = sum(coverage(nos) x credits(nos) for nos in practical_nos_for_matching) / sum(credits(nos) for nos in practical_nos_for_matching)
experience_rule: A practical NOS counts as 'has declared experience' only if at least one card/tool linked to one of its PCs was answered 'sometimes' or 'often' (i.e. effective_claim > 0 for at least one linked PC).

match_result_rules.label: Appropriate match
match_result_rules.condition: overall >= 0.60 AND every NOS in practical_nos_for_matching has declared experience

match_result_rules.label: Partial match — gaps
match_result_rules.condition: 0.35 <= overall < 0.60, OR (overall >= 0.60 AND one or more practical NOS has no declared experience). Assessment can still proceed; gaps are shown to worker and assessor.

match_result_rules.label: Not an appropriate match
match_result_rules.condition: overall < 0.35. Worker is told plainly; the assessor can still choose to open an assessment.

output_contract.because: list of short human-readable reasons naming the cards/tools and NOS that drove the result
output_contract.gap_nos: list of NOS codes below their own appropriate-match bar or with no declared experience
output_contract.applicable_tasks: T1-T5 always listed; tasks whose NOS is in gap_nos are marked extra_evidence_needed=true
output_contract.declaration_only_signals: per declaration_only_nos entry (CON/N8001, CON/N8002): has_declared_experience bool + matched card/tool ids + a worker-readable because line. Informational only — never read by match_result, overall_coverage, nos_coverage or gap_nos.

never_decides_competence: This matcher only explains how a self-declaration relates to CON/Q0602 v4.0 and which tasks need the most evidence. It never outputs pass/fail or a PC score — only a human assessor scores competence (see rubric.json). It explains fit and gaps and prioritises which tasks need the most evidence; it does not decide, score, or certify competence.
mvp_disclaimer: The 0.60 and 0.35 coverage thresholds above (and the answer_strength values 1.0/0.6/0.0) are MVP matching heuristics invented for this project to route a self-declaration to appropriate_match / partial_match / not_appropriate_match. They are NOT official NQR, NCVET, or CSDCI pass/competency thresholds — CON/Q0602 v4.0 (qp_v4.0.pdf) defines no such self-declaration-matching concept at all; its own pass rule is 'Minimum Aggregate Passing % at QP Level: 50' for a full formal assessment (qp.json.minimum_aggregate_passing_percent), which this matcher does not implement or approximate. Any UI, report, or document that shows a match result MUST make clear it is a heuristic routing/triage signal, not an official qualification outcome.
